description:
Search notes and logs by thread, person, type, date or text, and summarise activity per thread or person. Returns pointers (absolute paths plus metadata), never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--person P] [--text S] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json]  — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--person P] [--text S] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json]  — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--person P] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json]  — rank threads by what happened in a window (notes, logs, hours)
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json]  — the whole picture of one thread
  person PERSON [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json]  — the whole picture of one person
  stream [--thread T] [--kind K[,K...]] [--person P] [--text S] [--today] [--reverse] [--limit N] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json]  — every dated record, merged into one chronology

Flags:
  common:
    --thread / THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
    --person / PERSON  a declared person: full name or a unique part of one; matches links, assignees, attendees and the full name in text
    --since, --until  YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive
    --json  JSON output
  notes:
    --type  e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text  case-insensitive literal, searched in topic and body
    --limit  default 20; 0 = all
  logs:
    --text  case-insensitive literal, searched in entry lines
    --limit  default 20; 0 = all
  activity:
    --person  hours are not counted when this is set
  overview, person:
    --limit  recent items listed; default 5; 0 = all
  stream:
    --kind  comma-separated, from: note, log, task, done, dropped, hours, payment, thread, person, pending (default all)
    --text  case-insensitive literal, searched in thread and summary
    --today  same as --since and --until today
    --reverse  oldest first (default: newest first)
    --limit  default 100; 0 = all

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-10-01", "--json"]
  ["person", "Sam Rivera"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "task,done,hours"]
  ["overview", "Projects/Northwind", "--limit", "0"]

Notes:
  Read result files in a separate step (e.g. notes cat STEM). The paths returned are absolute; use them as given.
  Dates are the event date (the note's frontmatter timestamp), not the filename date.
  Hours descriptions are not searched by --text.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
